answer_length.note: Two features: character length and whitespace-separated word count of the supplied answer. The threshold was chosen on validation. AUROC does not use that threshold. halueval-pair-002 scored this baseline at threshold 0.5; do not mix the two F1 numbers.

baselines.lexical_overlap_note: Overlap uses the gold answer string. Under the pair protocol that string is the faithful answer, so this baseline can recover the label without hidden states.

majority.note: A constant prediction does not define AUROC or AUPRC. Those values were not filled in.

probe_auroc_interval.note: Percentile interval from resampling these scored rows with replacement. It does not transfer to another dataset.

shuffled_label.note: Training labels were permuted with the run seed. Test labels were left intact.

audit_notes: Source: HaluEval QA (Li et al., EMNLP 2023), file data/qa_data.json at commit 207f479c555a68b8d2431631a95083b84b2accbe, sha256 89ed139ec5e3a3169a0b30e45569ac1283846f76f27f7bb5e908ee6deed57e88. 10,000 JSONL rows with keys knowledge, question, right_answer, hallucinated_answer.

right_answer is the HotpotQA answer. hallucinated_answer is the benchmark's generated answer. A manual read of 12 unfiltered rows (seed 0) found gold facts repeated inside the hallucinated field and a yes/no answer paraphrased, so those patterns are filtered. A later read of filtered rows found a gold date restated as the same year, so identical number sets are filtered too. Remaining rows are still benchmark labels, not a full re-annotation.
The model prompt is the demo question prompt plus the supplied answer. The knowledge passage is stored for audit and is not fed to the model, because the demo does not have a passage.
This labels supplied answer strings. It does not label a new Qwen generation.
dataset.prompt: demo render_prompt(question) plus the supplied answer; knowledge is not in the prompt

metrics_note: Scores are probabilities of the HaluEval hallucinated-answer class for a supplied answer. They are not labels of a new model generation. Early detection and intervention were not run.

test_auroc_interval.note: Percentile interval from resampling these scored rows with replacement. It does not transfer to another dataset.

test_auroc_interval_note: Percentile interval from resampling these scored test rows with replacement. It does not transfer to another dataset or to Qwen's own generations. An interval does not validate calibration.

validation_layer_metrics.note: Validation only. This table does not choose the saved layer and does not read the test split.
